overviewParagraph: The Golden Designs St. Moritz 2 Person Barrel Traditional Sauna offers a luxurious outdoor retreat for relaxation and wellness. Crafted from Pacific Premium Cedar wood, this sauna is designed to provide soothing heat that promotes muscle relaxation, stress relief, and improved circulation. With a 6.0 kW stove and optional 8 kW upgrade, it efficiently heats up to 190°F, ensuring a rejuvenating experience. The elegant bronze privacy tempered glass door and interior LED accent lighting enhance its appeal, making it a perfect addition to your backyard oasis.

_raw.Product Ad-Copy: With a Golden Designs traditional barrel sauna, you can turn that dream of your very own home spa into a reality. Now with our outdoor barrel sauna you can place it anywhere in your yard avoiding taking up any space in your home. Enjoy the health benefits a traditional sauna brings to your life. Take the first step to a healthier life!
